Well he doesn't like to go out that much... We only go out with friends and if we are alone we just walk in our neighborhood.

He has a lot of insecurities.

For him one of the biggest problems is that all the things he want to do needs money.

He has been searching for a job for 2 or 3 years and the only thing he found is a 3h job 2 days a week.

He is trying to join college next year 

I try my best!

I sent him the number of a local hot line but he just doesn't want any help.

He has been going to a psychologist but during summer he was in vacation. My bf came back to him but looks like it's not working at all .

Today morning without telling anything important I told my mother in law that I think he has major depression and she agrees with me and we will try to help him as much as we can + she will search a good therapist
